definition: A quantity whose change, $\Delta G = \Delta H - T\Delta S$ (in $\pu{kJ mol-1}$), weighs a reaction's enthalpy change against its entropy change at absolute temperature $T$; a negative $\Delta G$ means the change is spontaneous.
A change that, once started, continues on its own under the stated conditions; at constant temperature and pressure its $\Delta G$ is negative, though it may still be very slow.
